pch.feedbackSubheading: Let us know how we did
pch.feedbackCommentPlaceholder: Share your opinion about this page...
pch.coffeeTagline: If this helped you, consider buying me a coffee ☕
pch.contactMessagePlaceholder: Describe your issue, question, or feedback...
pch.contactIntro: Got a technical issue? Want to give us feedback? Any questions? Any Suggestions? We'd love to hear from you. Send us a message and we'll respond as soon as possible.
pch.contactNoscript: This contact form requires JavaScript to be enabled. Please enable JavaScript, or email us directly at
pch.feedbackNoscript: Submitting feedback requires JavaScript to be enabled.
pch.authOr: or
pch.authLoginIntro: Sign in to track your progress and earn certificates.
pch.authSignupIntro: Free, and your progress follows you across devices.
pch.authResetIntro: We will email you a link to set a new password.
pch.authResetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
pch.authVerifyIntro: Certificates are issued only to verified addresses. Check your inbox for the link.
pch.authDeleteWarn: This permanently deletes your account, your progress, quiz scores, bookmarks and notes. It cannot be undone. Certificates you have already earned stay valid at their public link.
pch.authSignedOutNotice: Sign in to view this page.
pch.authErrInvalidCredential: That email and password do not match an account.
pch.authErrInvalidEmail: That does not look like a valid email address.
pch.authErrEmailInUse: An account already exists for that email. Try signing in instead.
pch.authErrWeakPassword: Password is too short — use at least 8 characters.
pch.authErrTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
pch.authErrNetwork: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
pch.authErrPopupClosed: The sign-in window closed before it finished.
pch.authErrDifferentProvider: That email is already registered with a different sign-in method.
pch.authErrRecentLogin: For security, sign in again before making this change.
pch.authErrProviderDisabled: That sign-in method is not available yet.
pch.authErrGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
pch.dashContinue: Pick up where you left off
pch.dashNoBookmarks: Nothing saved yet. Use the bookmark button at the foot of any page.
pch.dashNoProgress: No lessons marked complete yet. Open a lesson from any course and use “Mark as complete” at the end of it.
pch.dashLocalOnly: Your progress is saved on this device. Sign in to keep it across devices.
pch.examSignIn: Final assessments are marked against your account, so you need to sign in first.
pch.examVerify: Verify your email address before sitting the assessment — a certificate names the address it is issued to.
pch.examPassed: You passed. Your certificate is ready to claim.
pch.examFailed: Not this time. Revisit the lessons you found hardest and sit it again in ten minutes.
pch.examMissing: This course does not have a final assessment yet.
pch.certNone: No certificates yet. Finish a course and pass its final assessment to earn one.
pch.boardIntro: Everyone here chose to be listed. Totals are recalculated on the server from completed lessons and earned certificates, so they cannot be typed in.
pch.boardEmpty: Nobody has joined yet. You could be first.
pch.prefLeaderboardHint: Lists your display name and total publicly. Turning this off removes your entry.
pch.prefDigest: Email me when I'm close to a certificate
pch.prefDigestHint: At most one email a week, and only when you are within five pages.
